o1: Enables cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding activity. Involved in defense response to Gram-negative bacterium; determination of adult lifespan; and positive regulation of dauer larval development. Is located in condensed chromosome; cytoplasm; and nucleus. Is expressed in P1; P10; hermaphrodite distal tip cell; hypodermal cell; and neurons. Is part of the TGF-β receptor signaling pathway.
